name: anchor
label: Jump-link name (optional)
help_text: Optional. A short word with no spaces, such as score. Other links can then jump straight to this section by pointing at #score.

name: alt_bg
label: Alternate background
help_text: Turn on to give this section a tinted background so neighbouring sections alternate between light and white.

name: heading
label: Heading
default: Our score and the latest comments, straight from the survey

name: intro
label: Intro
help_text: One or two sentences under the heading.

name: customer_number
label: CEO Juice customer number
help_text: VAF's customer number at CEO Juice. It identifies whose score and comments to show.

name: show_widget
label: Show the live NPS score and awards
help_text: Shows CEO Juice's own score panel: the World Class badge, the score against well-known companies, and the chart. It updates on its own.

name: widget_title
label: Score panel title (for screen readers)
default: Van Ausdall & Farrar Net Promoter Score, live from CEO Juice

name: show_comments
label: Show the latest customer comments
help_text: Shows the newest survey comments, filled in live. If CEO Juice cannot be reached, this block stays hidden.

name: auth_key
label: CEO Juice comments key
help_text: The key CEO Juice gives VAF for the comments feed (the same one the old site used). Leave blank to hide the live comments.

name: comments_heading
label: Comments heading
default: What customers said after their last service call

name: source
label: Source note
help_text: A short line under the section about where the numbers come from.
